hero.title: Our Story
hero.description: Discover the passion and craftsmanship behind every frozen delight. We're committed to creating the finest frozen desserts using only the freshest ingredients.

items.title: The Beginning
items.description: Started as a small family kitchen with a dream to create the perfect frozen dessert. Our first shop opened with just three flavors.

items.title: Expanding Our Horizons
items.description: Expanded to multiple locations across the city. Introduced seasonal flavors and gained recognition for our premium quality.

items.title: Innovation Award
items.description: Received the prestigious Innovation in Frozen Desserts award. Launched our signature collection of artisan ice creams.

items.title: Going Green
items.description: Transitioned to 100% sustainable packaging and sourced all dairy from local farms. Our commitment to the environment grew stronger.

items.title: Today
items.description: With over 50 locations nationwide, we continue to innovate and bring joy through our frozen creations. Every scoop tells a story.

step_into_our_frozen_world.title: Step into Our Frozen World
step_into_our_frozen_world.description: Our shop isn’t just a place to eat — it’s an experience. With interiors inspired by snow-covered landscapes, frosty designs, and warm corners, every visit feels like stepping into a magical frozen escape. From the first glance to the last bite, your senses are wrapped in a snowy celebration.

values.title: Freshness First
values.description: We source locally whenever possible, ensuring our ingredients are at their peak of flavor and nutrition. From farm to bowl, we prioritize freshness in every bite.

values.title: Crafted with Care
values.description: Our ice creams are made fresh daily in small batches, while our salads are thoughtfully composed to create perfect harmony in flavor, texture, and nutrition.

values.title: Balance in Every Bite
values.description: We believe in the power of balance – between indulgence and nourishment, tradition and innovation, simplicity and complexity in our food and in life.

values.title: Community & Connection
values.description: Our spaces are designed to bring people together, where strangers become friends over shared meals and meaningful conversations.
